data.name: Geri
data.long_meaning: The name Geri is derived from the Greek word 'geranos', meaning crane or a farmworker. It is also associated with the Greek goddess Geranios, who was believed to protect farmers and their crops. In Christianity, Geri is a diminutive form of Gerasimos, which means 'venerable one' or 'aged one'. This name carries a sense of rustic charm and hardworking spirit.
